list.name: vre sentences
list.word: I was tired after my scary adventure.
The daring stuntman was injured by the barbed wire.
I could barely stay awake at the retirement home.
My parents took a picture of the church spire.
Be careful that the fire does not injure you.
His grandparents drink pure spring water.
I admire the doctor who cured me.
Beware of being robbed in the town square.
